releaseNotes:
• Media Player 3-Dots Popup: Dynamically anchored to 3-dots button with morphing corner radius and navbar liquid glass UI
• Mid-Size Floating Indicator Bar: Reduced to compact mid-size with stable frosted acrylic backdrop eliminating swipe blur shift
• ColorOS Lockscreen Lyrics: Real-time broadcast intent hook with unlocked OPlus SystemUI lockscreen compatibility
• Phone Quick Controls Next Button: Media3 ForwardingPlayer exposing next/previous seek commands in notification controls
• Next Up Control Pills: Sleek icon-only circular pills, blurred white active state, and transparent glass when off
• Reduced Next Up Blur: Tuned background blur to 8.dp with lightened ambient overlay tint
• Album Set Container Redesign: Bottom navbar liquid glass design language with increased cover sizes and tap morph animation
• Cohesive Next Up Queue: Strictly seeds upcoming songs from active artist, language, and genre
• Artist Page Song Background: Added translucent frosted glass background effect to artist song items
• Onboarding Logo Refinement: Decreased initial app opening logo size by 80%
• Zero Homescreen Scroll Lag: Coil memory pre-warming and cached item derivation for stutter-free scrolling
